Once upon a time there was a little girl called Goldilocks.
She had long golden hair, and she loved to explore.
One morning she went for a walk in the forest, and she found a little house.
The door was open, so she peeked inside.
In the house lived three bears.
Papa Bear was big, Mama Bear was middle-sized and Baby Bear was very small.
They had gone for a walk while their porridge cooled.
On the table stood three bowls of porridge.
Goldilocks tasted the porridge in the big bowl.
Oh, this porridge is too hot,
said Goldilocks.
She tasted the porridge in the middle bowl.
Oh, this porridge is too cold,
Then she tasted the porridge in the little bowl.
Mmm, this porridge is just right,
said Goldilocks, and she ate it all up.
Goldilocks went into the next room.
There were three chairs.
She sat in the big chair.
This chair is too hard,
She sat in the middle chair.
This chair is too soft,
Then she sat in the little chair.
This chair is just right,
But crack!
The little chair broke into pieces.
Goldilocks was sleepy, so she went upstairs.
There were three beds.
She lay on the big bed, but it was too high.
She lay on the middle bed, but it was too lumpy.
Then she lay on the little bed, and it was just right.
Soon she was fast asleep.
The three bears came home.
Papa Bear looked at the table.
Somebody has been eating my porridge,
said Papa Bear.
said Mama Bear.
Somebody has been eating my porridge, and it is all gone!
said Baby Bear.
The bears looked at the chairs.
Somebody has been sitting in my chair,
Somebody has been sitting in my chair, and it is broken!
Then the three bears went upstairs.
Somebody has been sleeping in my bed,
Somebody is sleeping in my bed, and she is still here!
Goldilocks woke up and saw the three bears.
Oh dear!
She jumped out of the bed, ran down the stairs and out of the door, and she did not stop until she was home.
I am sorry I ate your porridge,
she said to herself.
And she never went into the bears' house again.
